title: Restatement § 79 — adequacy and mutuality
summary: Once consideration exists, adequacy is a separate concern from the bargain’s legal sufficiency.
notes: The notes use the provision to distinguish an actual exchange from an equal exchange and to examine nominal consideration. The full SEL provision and illustrations are missing; this entry does not substitute a reconstructed statutory-style quotation.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 58–61. Open assigned page 58.
